Reasoning: This stage keeps the panda_fingertip pose fixed while establishing a real grasp on cube_2. freeze_position fixes the current end-effector origin with no commanded world translation, and freeze_orientation fixes the current end-effector orientation with no commanded tool rotation. object_grasped is used instead of close_gripper because the requirement is a firm physical grasp of cube_2 and the API forbids emitting both close_gripper and object_grasped in one list. The explicit left/right gripper joint command toward 0.0 and detailed finger effort/contact monitoring are not separately representable beyond the object_grasped requirement; manipulator_high_effort is not used because it refers to arm/TCP effort, not finger squeeze.
